# The Meet Rack Setup and Teardown Crew

Help us build the space and put it away again

In addition to monitors, the Meet Rack needs volunteers to help us set up and tear down the space. It is a quick transition between the end of classes and the beginning of the party, and we desperately need all the extra help we can get here.

This is a great opportunity to help make the Rack a successful experience for everyone while still getting the opportunity to participate in the grope-a-thon!

Setup and Teardown is a short, concrete commitment. You are not signing up to monitor the Rack, and you do not need any prior Meet Rack experience.

**We Really need you!**

Note that Setup/Teardown can count as a "chore" in the chore system.

## When do you need me?

*   Setup: Saturday evening 7:00–8:00 PM
*   Teardown: from 10:30 PM until the space is clear

You are welcome to help with setup, teardown, or both. Even one of the two is a real help.

## What does the crew actually do?

*   Hang rope loops and attachment points from the overhead structures
*   Move and place furniture, equipment, and the safety tables
*   Set out gloves, hand sanitizer, cups, cards, and pens
*   Mark off and lay out the Rack and the separate Locker space
*   At the end of the night, take it all down, sort it, and return it

### We are particularly looking for people with these (not required) skills:

*   Have comfort with tying basic knots and rope tension
*   Feel comfortable climbing/standing on precarious things
*   Can move heavy items

None of these are requirements. If you can carry things and follow directions, there is a job for you.

If you're able to help, please reach out to [Fetlife - Torque](https://www.fetlife.com/torque) or @Torque on Discord as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance — we can't do it without you!
